data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 8a5d6ed4b2905640c910e39df7a297c079414404

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (test-infrastructure leak, sibling to dae6-3db9-9eea-4009)

#### Expected Behavior

All EXIT traps in test scripts must chain on top of git-fixtures.sh's `_cleanup` EXIT trap (registered at git-fixtures.sh line 50 when sourced), so that `_CLEANUP_DIRS` fixture temp-dirs and any local sidecar temp-files are removed on process exit. The established fix idiom is in tests/run-all.sh lines 72-96 (capture prior trap via `trap -p EXIT | sed ...`, then register a chained trap that appends to it).

#### Actual Behavior

Two sibling files have the same EXIT-trap clobber pattern fixed in dae6-3db9-9eea-4009:

**1. tests/scripts/test-retro-gather-suggestions.sh**

- Line 28: `source "$REPO_ROOT/tests/lib/git-fixtures.sh"` — registers `trap _cleanup EXIT`
- Line 75: `trap 'rm -f "$_tmpout"' EXIT` — overwrites `_cleanup`
- Line 102: `trap 'rm -f "$_empty_tmp"' EXIT` — overwrites line-75 trap
- Line 128: `trap 'rm -f "$_nodir_tmp"' EXIT` — overwrites line-102 trap

Result: only the last trap (line 128) survives; `_CLEANUP_DIRS` entries registered via `_CLEANUP_DIRS+=("$_REPO_WITH")` (line 34) are never cleaned. `_tmpout` and `_empty_tmp` temp files (from lines 74 and 101) also leak because their traps were overwritten.

**2. tests/scripts/test-audit-source-consumers.sh**

- Line 37: `_AUDIT_EXIT_FILE="$(mktemp ...)"` — creates sidecar temp file
- Line 39: `trap 'rm -f "$_AUDIT_EXIT_FILE"' EXIT` — registers cleanup for it
- Line 42: `source "$REPO_ROOT/tests/lib/git-fixtures.sh"` — overwrites line-39 trap with `trap _cleanup EXIT`

Result: `_AUDIT_EXIT_FILE` is never removed on exit (its cleanup trap was overwritten by git-fixtures.sh).

#### Fix direction

Same as dae6-3db9-9eea-4009: use the `trap -p EXIT | sed ...` capture idiom before each `trap ... EXIT` call, then register a chained trap that calls both the new handler and the prior body. Or refactor each sidecar to use `_CLEANUP_DIRS+=("$file")` so git-fixtures' `_cleanup` covers it, and remove the raw `trap ... EXIT` calls.
data.title: [test-retro-gather-suggestions.sh|test-audit-source-consumers.sh]: trap ... EXIT clobbers git-fixtures.sh _cleanup -> _CLEANUP_DIRS and sidecar temp-files leak
